description: Ask a buyer's Buying Agent to accept a negotiated offer, forwarded to their buyer MCP. The agent auto-accepts only within the buyer's delegation caps, otherwise it queues the offer for the buyer's approval.

amount_usd.description: Total order amount in USD, for the caps check.

buyer_mcp_url.description: The buyer's mcp_url from a find_buyers result.

category.description: Product category, checked against the buyer's lists.

offer_id.description: Your reference id for the offer being accepted.

name: accept_offer
